# Figure provenance

The six figures named `measurement_problem`, `thickness_retrieval`,
`structured_retrieval`, `rdw_retrieval`, `trace_validation` and
`smearing_examples` were copied from the corresponding PNG outputs of the
associated unpublished drafts during the documentation review on 14 October
2026. Their captions in `explanation/validation.md` identify protocols, field
planes and limitations. They are static evidence figures, not outputs generated
by the bundled illustrative scripts. Builds have no dependency on manuscript
paths. The draft's figure sources and compact arrays remain the provenance of
these plotted numerical results; they have not been rerun as part of this edit.

The older `figure_*` assets are retained for URL compatibility. Quantitative
validation figures from that earlier protocol are no longer used to substantiate
the revised results. Their superseded text is retained in the excluded editorial
record `docs/_review/superseded_validation.md` for follow-up if needed.
